name: ledger
note: N5a item 5. Ledger by distance (backdrop_m is 0 in tiers.json, so no pack is unloaded for distance unless a world says so, as here). The player walks away from b and c until they are more than 250 + 40 m off: both are unloaded (ticks, summary and what the pack saved itself are kept), then he walks back and both are rebuilt from their seed. c (ex_wall) has no _pack_save: it starts its game again and hashes as a fresh run of its new ticks. b (ex_bounce) has _pack_save/_pack_load: its score comes back, so it is not comparable with a run from the seed.
